desc: Constructed from 7075 T6 aluminum, and coming with a heat sheild, the VRPA40 is unmatched in pump shotguns. Its magazine fed with a 5+1 capacity of 2-3/4" and 3" shells. Interchangeble Magazine with other RIA VR Series Shotguns, its capability and versatility make the VRPA a clear leader in pump action mag fed shotguns for a fraction of the price.
